The random forest reaches **91.4% test accuracy** (0.9135) on 185 held-out patients.

What I did:
- **Data:** 921 rows, 8 features, no missing values. Zeros in insulin (477), skin thickness (280) and a few other columns probably mean "missing", but I kept them as values rather than imputing.
